description: This file contains action creators and utility functions for handling app bindings, form submissions, navigation, and ephemeral posts within the Mattermost web application, specifically related to app interactions in channels.

methods.name: handleBindingClick
methods.description: Handles click events on app bindings, fetching forms or submitting data as needed.

methods.name: doAppSubmit
methods.description: Submits an app call request and processes the response, handling different response types including form, navigate, error, and ok.

methods.name: doAppFetchForm
methods.description: Fetches a form from the app call response and processes it.

methods.name: doAppLookup
methods.description: Performs an app call to lookup data and returns the response.

methods.name: makeFetchBindings
methods.description: Creates a function to fetch app bindings for a specific location.

methods.name: openAppsModal
methods.description: Opens a modal dialog for app forms.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForPost
methods.description: Posts an ephemeral message response related to a specific post.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForChannel
methods.description: Posts an ephemeral message response for a specific channel.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForContext
methods.description: Posts an ephemeral message response within a specific app context.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForCommandArgs
methods.description: Posts an ephemeral message response based on command arguments.
